title: Meta's longtime content policy chief Monika Bickert leaving to teach at Harvard - The Hindu
summary: Monika Bickert, Facebook's long-time content policy chief, is leaving for a teaching position at Harvard Law School. Her role included overseeing content policies and addressing controversies related to user safety and political content.
sentiment_reason: The departure of a key figure in content policy management and the ongoing controversies surrounding Facebook's handling of sensitive issues contribute to a negative sentiment due to potential impacts on the company's reputation and policy enforcement.
